intent.proves: Positive, negative, nested, empty and boundary cases run through the real engine. Characterize reversed contains, alternatives arrays for in, checkbox submissions, nulls, coercion and legacy negated lists. No result is inferred from the name of an operator.
intent.scope: Exact declared model/version, catalogue and case set on the target with loaded package and assembly hashes; complete observations only. Missing identity, denied access or truncated scope is UNVERIFIED.

bindings.reason: No CPQ behavior-receipt reader is implemented. Consume complete fresh evidence from an isolated producer, bound to trusted host/run/model/spec/package/ledger identities and independent golden cases. Never mutate the target from the ledger checker or treat schema validation as PASS.
